en: How many schools with an average score in Math greater than 400 in the SAT test are exclusively virtual?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.School) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Virtual = 'F' AND T1.AvgScrMath > 400

en: Among the schools with an SAT excellence rate of over 0.3, what is the highest eligible free rate for students aged 5-17?
postgres: SELECT MAX(CAST(T1."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS REAL) / NULLIF(T1."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0)) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE CAST(T2.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NULLIF(T2.NumTstTakr, 0) > 0.3

en: State the names and full communication address of high schools in Monterey which has more than 800 free or reduced price meals for ages 15-17?
postgres: SELECT T1."School Name", T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Monterey' AND T1."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800 AND T1."School Type" = 'High Schools (Public)'

en: Consider the average difference between K-12 enrollment and 15-17 enrollment of schools that are locally funded, list the names and DOC type of schools which has a difference above this average.
postgres: SELECT T2.School, T2.DOC FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND (T1."Enrollment (K-12)" - T1."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (SELECT AVG(T3."Enrollment (K-12)" - T3."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") FROM frpm AS T3 INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded')

en: What is the eligible free rate of the 10th and 11th schools with the highest enrolment for students in grades 1 through 12?
postgres: SELECT CAST("Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS REAL) / NULLIF("Enrollment (K-12)", 0) FROM frpm ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

en: What is the eligible free or reduced price meal rate for the top 5 schools in grades 1-12 with the highest free or reduced price meal count of the schools with the ownership code 66?
postgres: SELECT CAST(T1."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS REAL) / NULLIF(T1."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.SOC::integer = 66 ORDER BY T1."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

en: What is the average number of test takers from Fresno schools that opened between 1/1/1980 and 12/31/1980?
postgres: SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.OpenDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '1980' AND T2.County = 'Fresno'

en: What is the telephone number for the school with the lowest average score in reading in Fresno Unified?
postgres: SELECT T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.District = 'Fresno Unified' AND NOT T1.AvgScrRead IS NULL ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

en: Which state special schools have the highest number of enrollees from grades 1 through 12?
postgres: SELECT T2.School FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.DOC = '31' ORDER BY T1."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 1

en: What is the monthly average number of schools that opened in Alameda County under the jurisdiction of the Elementary School District in 1980?
postgres: SELECT CAST(COUNT(School) AS REAL) / NULLIF(12, 0) FROM schools WHERE DOC = '52' AND County = 'Alameda' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OpenDate) = 1980

en: What is the ratio of merged Unified School District schools in Orange County to merged Elementary School District schools?
postgres: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DOC::integer = 54 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DOC::integer = 52 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM schools WHERE StatusType = 'Merged' AND County = 'Orange'

en: Between San Diego and Santa Barbara, which county offers the most number of schools that does not offer physical building? Indicate the amount.
postgres: SELECT County, COUNT(Virtual) FROM schools WHERE (County = 'San Diego' OR County = 'Santa Barbara') AND Virtual = 'F' GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(Virtual) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

en: What is the grade span offered in the school with the highest longitude?
postgres: SELECT GSoffered FROM schools ORDER BY ABS(longitude) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

en: Of the schools that offers a magnet program serving a grade span of Kindergarten to 8th grade, how many offers Multiple Provision Types? List the number of cities that offers a Kindergarten to 8th grade span and indicate how many schools are there serving such grade span for each city.
postgres: SELECT T2.City, COUNT(T2.CDSCode) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Magnet = 1 AND T2.GSoffered = 'K-8' AND T1."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types' GROUP BY T2.City

en: For artifact type of cards that do not have multiple faces on the same card, state its legalities status for vintage play format.
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T2.status FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.type = 'Artifact' AND T2.format = 'vintage' AND T1.side IS NULL

en: How many cards have infinite power?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power = '*'

en: What is the border color of card "Ancestor's Chosen"?
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT borderColor FROM cards WHERE name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'

en: What is the percentage of borderless cards?
postgres: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN borderColor = 'borderless' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(id), 0) FROM cards

en: What is the percentage of cards whose language is French among the Story Spotlight cards?
postgres: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.id), 0) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.isStorySpotlight = 1

en: How many cards with original type of "Summon - Angel" have subtype other than "Angel"?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM cards WHERE originalType = 'Summon - Angel' AND subtypes <> 'Angel'

en: Among the Artifact cards, which are black color and comes with foreign languague translation?
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.originalType = 'Artifact' AND T1.colors = 'B'

en: How many Brazilian Portuguese translated sets are inside the Commander block?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.code = T2.setCode WHERE T2.language = 'Portuguese (Brazil)' AND T1.block = 'Commander'

en: Indicates the number of cards with pre-modern format, ruling text "This is a triggered mana ability." that do not have multiple faces.
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid INNER JOIN rulings AS T3 ON T1.uuid = T3.uuid WHERE T2.format = 'premodern' AND T3.text = 'This is a triggered mana ability.' AND T1.Side IS NULL

en: What is the foreign name of the card in French of type Creature, normal layout and black border color, by artist Matthew D. Wilson?
postgres: SELECT name FROM foreign_data WHERE uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM cards WHERE types = 'Creature' AND layout = 'normal' AND borderColor = 'black' AND artist = 'Matthew D. Wilson') AND language = 'French'

en: What language is the set of 180 cards that belongs to the Ravnica block translated into?
postgres: SELECT T2.language FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.code = T2.setCode WHERE T1.block = 'Ravnica' AND T1.baseSetSize = 180

en: What is the language of the card with the multiverse number 149934?
postgres: SELECT language FROM foreign_data WHERE multiverseid = 149934

en: What languages are available in the set known as Archenemy on the magic card market and having the code ARC?
postgres: SELECT T2.language FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.code = T2.setCode WHERE T1.mcmName = 'Archenemy' AND T2.setCode = 'ARC'

en: Which card costs more converted mana, "Serra Angel" or "Shrine Keeper"?
postgres: SELECT name FROM cards WHERE name IN ('Serra Angel', 'Shrine Keeper') ORDER BY convertedManaCost DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

en: What's the Italian name of the set of cards with "Ancestor's Chosen" is in?
postgres: SELECT translation FROM set_translations WHERE setCode IN (SELECT setCode FROM cards WHERE name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen') AND language = 'Italian'

en: For the set of cards with "Ancestor's Chosen" in it, is there a Korean version of it?
postgres: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN T2.language = 'Korean' AND NOT T2.translation IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.setCode WHERE T1.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'

en: What is the Simplified Chinese translation of the name of the set "Eighth Edition"?
postgres: SELECT T2.translation FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T1.name = 'Eighth Edition' AND T2.language = 'Chinese Simplified'

en: Among the cards with converted mana cost higher than 5 in the set Coldsnap, how many of them have unknown power?
postgres: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.power = '*' OR T1.power IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.convertedManaCost > 5

en: How many posts does the user csgillespie own?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'

en: Who is the owner of the post "Eliciting priors from experts"?
postgres: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts'

en: What is the display name of the user who last edited the post "Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation"?
postgres: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.LastEditorUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation'

en: Among the posts owned by an elder user, how many of them have a score of over 19?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Score >= 20 AND T2.Age > 65

en: From which post is the tag "bayesian" excerpted from? Please give the body of the post.
postgres: SELECT T2.Body FROM tags AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T2.Id = T1.ExcerptPostId WHERE T1.TagName = 'bayesian'

en: Among the posts with a score of over 5, what is the percentage of them being owned by an elder user?
postgres: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Age > 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.Id), 0) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Score > 5

en: For the user with the display name of "Tiago Pasqualini", how many posts did he/she own?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Tiago Pasqualini'

en: Provide the display name of the user who made the vote No.6347.
postgres: SELECT T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Id = 6347

en: How many views did the post titled 'Integration of Weka and/or RapidMiner into Informatica PowerCenter/Developer' get?
postgres: SELECT ViewCount FROM posts WHERE Title = 'Integration of Weka and/or RapidMiner into Informatica PowerCenter/Developer'

en: Write the contents of comments with a score of 17.
postgres: SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE Score = 17

en: Which user made a post titled 'Understanding what Dassault iSight is doing?' and how much is the reputation of the user?
postgres: SELECT T1.DisplayName, T1.Reputation FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T2.Title = 'Understanding what Dassault iSight is doing?'

en: Who is the owner of the post titled 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data?'
postgres: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data?'

en: Which user added a bounty amount of 50 to the post title mentioning variance?
postgres: SELECT T3.DisplayName, T1.Title FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId INNER JOIN users AS T3 ON T3.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.BountyAmount = 50 AND T1.Title LIKE '%variance%'

en: How many users are awarded with more than 5 badges?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(UserId) FROM (SELECT UserId, COUNT(Name) AS num FROM badges GROUP BY UserId) AS T WHERE T.num > 5

en: Which user have only one post history per post and having at least 1000 views?
postgres: SELECT T2.UserId FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T2.PostId = T3.Id WHERE T3.ViewCount >= 1000 GROUP BY T2.UserId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.PostHistoryTypeId) = 1

en: What is the percentage difference of student badges given during 2010 and 2011?
postgres: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST(Date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(Id), 0) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST(Date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(Id), 0) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Student'

en: Which post by slashnick has the most answers count? State the post ID.
postgres: SELECT T2.PostId FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T2.PostId = T3.Id WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'slashnick' ORDER BY T3.AnswerCount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

en: When did 'chl' cast its first vote in a post?
postgres: SELECT T2.CreationDate FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'chl' ORDER BY T2.CreationDate NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

en: Among the users located in United Kingdom, how many users whose post have a total favorite amount of 4 or more?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.Location = 'United Kingdom' AND T2.FavoriteCount >= 4

en: What is the ratio of customers who pay in EUR against customers who pay in CZK?
postgres: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM customers

en: In 2012, who had the least consumption in LAM?
postgres: SELECT T1.CustomerID FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' GROUP BY T1.CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

en: Which year recorded the most consumption of gas paid in CZK?
postgres: SELECT SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

en: What was the gas consumption peak month for SME customers in 2013?
postgres: SELECT SUBSTR(T2.Date, 5, 2) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' AND T1.Segment = 'SME' GROUP BY SUBSTR(T2.Date, 5, 2) ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

en: How much did customer 6 consume in total between August and November 2013?
postgres: SELECT SUM(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = 6 AND Date BETWEEN '201308' AND '201311'

en: How many more "discount" gas stations does the Czech Republic have compared to Slovakia?
postgres: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Country = 'CZE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Country = 'SVK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM gasstations WHERE Segment = 'Discount'

en: Is it true that more SMEs pay in Czech koruna than in euros? If so, how many more?
postgres: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME'

en: In February 2012, what percentage of customers consumed more than 528.3?
postgres: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(CustomerID), 0) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date = '201202'

en: Please list the countries of the gas stations with transactions taken place in June, 2013.
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Country FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T3 ON T1.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID WHERE T3.Date = '201306'

en: Please list the disparate time of the transactions taken place in the gas stations from chain no. 11.
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Time FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T2.ChainID = 11

en: Among the transactions made in the gas stations in the Czech Republic, how many of them are taken place after 2012/1/1?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.TransactionID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T2.Country = 'CZE' AND TO_CHAR(CAST(T1.Date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') >= '2012'

en: What kind of currency did the customer paid at 16:25:00 in 2012/8/24?
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T3.Currency FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID INNER JOIN customers AS T3 ON T1.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Time = '16:25:00'

en: For all the transactions happened during 8:00-9:00 in 2012/8/26, how many happened in CZE?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.TransactionID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-26' AND T1.Time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00' AND T2.Country = 'CZE'

en: What is the percentage of "premium" against the overall segment in Country = "SVK"?
postgres: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Country = 'SVK' AND Segment = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Country = 'SVK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM gasstations

en: For all the people who paid more than 29.00 per unit of product id No.5. Give their consumption status in the August of 2012.
postgres: SELECT T2.Consumption FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Price / NULLIF(T1.Amount, 0) > 29.00 AND T1.ProductID = 5 AND T2.Date = '201208'

en: Give the name of the league had the most goals in the 2016 season?
postgres: SELECT t2.name FROM Match AS t1 INNER JOIN League AS t2 ON t1.league_id = t2.id WHERE t1.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY t2.name ORDER BY SUM(t1.home_team_goal + t1.away_team_goal) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

en: What are the speed in which attacks are put together of the top 4 teams with the highest build Up Play Speed?
postgres: SELECT t1.buildUpPlaySpeed FROM Team_Attributes AS t1 INNER JOIN Team AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id ORDER BY t1.buildUpPlaySpeed ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 4

en: Give the name of the league had the most matches end as draw in the 2016 season?
postgres: SELECT t2.name FROM Match AS t1 INNER JOIN League AS t2 ON t1.league_id = t2.id WHERE t1.season = '2015/2016' AND t1.home_team_goal = t1.away_team_goal GROUP BY t2.name ORDER BY COUNT(t1.id) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

en: List the football players with a birthyear of 1970 and a birthmonth of October.
postgres: SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 7) = '1970-10'

en: What is the overall rating of the football player Gabriel Tamas in year 2011?
postgres: SELECT t2.overall_rating FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas' AND TO_CHAR(CAST(t2.date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2011'

en: Calculate the average home team goal in the 2010/2011 season in the country of Poland.
postgres: SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.home_team_goal) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(t2.id), 0) FROM Country AS t1 INNER JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.country_id WHERE t1.name = 'Poland' AND t2.season = '2010/2011'

en:
What is the difference of the average ball control score between Abdou Diallo and Aaron Appindangoye
?
postgres: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN t2.ball_control ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN t2.id ELSE NULL END), 0) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN t2.ball_control ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN t2.id ELSE NULL END), 0) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id

en: Which player is older, Aaron Lennon or Abdelaziz Barrada?
postgres: SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE player_name IN ('Aaron Lennon', 'Abdelaziz Barrada') ORDER BY birthday ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

en: Among the players whose preferred foot was the left foot when attacking, how many of them would remain in his position when the team attacked?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(player_api_id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND attacking_work_rate = 'low'

en: Among the players born before the year 1986, how many of them would remain in his position and defense while the team attacked?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.player_name) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(t1.birthday AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') < '1986' AND t2.defensive_work_rate = 'high'

en: How many matches were held in the Belgium Jupiler League in April, 2009?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(t2.id) FROM League AS t1 INNER JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.league_id WHERE t1.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND SUBSTR(t2."date", 1, 7) = '2009-04'

en: What is Ajax's highest chance creation passing score and what is it classified as?
postgres: SELECT t2.chanceCreationPassing, t2.chanceCreationPassingClass FROM Team AS t1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t1.team_long_name = 'Ajax' ORDER BY t2.chanceCreationPassing DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

en: What was the overall rating for Aaron Mooy on 2016/2/4?
postgres: SELECT t2.overall_rating FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE SUBSTR(t2."date", 1, 10) = '2016-02-04' AND t1.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy'

en: What was the average overall rating for Marko Arnautovic from 2007/2/22 to 2016/4/21?
postgres: SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.overall_rating) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(t2.id), 0) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_fifa_api_id = t2.player_fifa_api_id WHERE t1.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' AND SUBSTR(t2."date", 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

en: List down most tallest players' name.
postgres: SELECT player_name FROM (SELECT player_name, height, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS rank FROM Player) AS subquery WHERE rank = 1

en: State the name of the most strongest player.
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT t1.player_name FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t2.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)

en: What are the short name of team who played safe while creating chance of passing?
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT t1.team_short_name FROM Team AS t1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'

en: How many football players born after the 1990s have the first name "Aaron"?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM Player WHERE birthday > '1990' AND player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'

en: Does the KSV Cercle Brugge team have a slow, balanced or fast speed class?
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT t1.buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team_Attributes AS t1 INNER JOIN Team AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'

en: How many accounts who choose issuance after transaction are staying in East Bohemia region?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T2.account_id) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.A3 = 'east Bohemia' AND T2.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

en: List out the no. of districts that have female average salary is more than 6000 but less than 10000?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.district_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND T2.A11 BETWEEN 6000 AND 10000

en: How many male customers who are living in North Bohemia have average salary greater than 8000?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'M' AND T2.A3 = 'north Bohemia' AND T2.A11 > 8000

en: List out the account numbers of clients who are youngest and have highest average salary?
postgres: SELECT T1.account_id FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id INNER JOIN district AS T4 ON T4.district_id = T1.district_id WHERE T2.client_id = (SELECT client_id FROM client ORDER BY birth_date DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) GROUP BY T4.A11, T1.account_id

en: Among the accounts who have approved loan date in 1997, list out the accounts that have the lowest approved amount and choose weekly issuance statement.
postgres: SELECT T2.account_id FROM loan AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(T1.date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '1997' AND T2.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY T1.amount NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

en: Among the accounts who have loan validity more than 12 months, list out the accounts that have the highest approved amount and have account opening date in 1993.
postgres: SELECT T1.account_id FROM loan AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '1993' AND T1.duration > 12 ORDER BY T1.amount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

en: Among the account opened, how many female customers who were born before 1950 and stayed in Sokolov?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T2.client_id) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T2.gender = 'F' AND TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.birth_date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') < '1950' AND T1.A2 = 'Sokolov'

en: For the female client who was born in 1976/1/29, which district did she opened her account?
postgres: SELECT T1.A2 FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T2.birth_date = '1976-01-29' AND T2.gender = 'F'

en: For the client whose loan was approved first in 1993/7/5, what is the increase rate of his/her account balance from 1993/3/22 to 1998/12/27?
postgres: SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN T3.date = '1998-12-27' THEN T3.balance ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T3.date = '1993-03-22' THEN T3.balance ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.date = '1993-03-22' THEN T3.balance ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM loan AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T3.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T1.date = '1993-07-05'

en: Which are the top ten withdrawals (non-credit card) by district names for the month of January 1996?
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T1.A2 FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T3.type = 'VYDAJ' AND CAST(T3.date AS TEXT) LIKE '1996-01%' ORDER BY T1.A2 ASC LIMIT 10

en: Between 1/1/1995 and 12/31/1997, how many loans in the amount of at least 250,000 per account that chose monthly statement issuance were approved?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.account_id) FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T2.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND T2.amount >= 250000

en: What is the average number of crimes committed in 1995 in regions where the number exceeds 4000 and the region has accounts that are opened starting from the year 1997?
postgres: SELECT AVG(T1.A15) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') >= '1997' AND T1.A15 > 4000

en: What was the growth rate of the total amount of loans across all accounts for a male client between 1996 and 1997?
postgres: SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST(T1.date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '1997' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST(T1.date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '1996' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST(T1.date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '1996' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM loan AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T3.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN client AS T4 ON T4.client_id = T3.client_id WHERE T4.gender = 'M' AND T3.type = 'OWNER'

en: How often does account number 3 request an account statement to be released? What was the aim of debiting 3539 in total?
postgres: SELECT T1.frequency, T2.k_symbol FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id, k_symbol, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id, k_symbol) AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T1.account_id = 3 AND T2.total_amount = 3539

en: Name the account numbers of female clients who are oldest and have lowest average salary?
postgres: SELECT T3.account_id FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id INNER JOIN disp AS T4 ON T1.client_id = T4.client_id AND T4.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' ORDER BY T1.birth_date ASC NULLS FIRST, T2.A11 ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

en: Provide the IDs and age of the client with high level credit card, which is eligible for loans.
postgres: SELECT T1.client_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T3.birth_date) AS age FROM disp AS T1 INNER JOIN card AS T2 ON T2.disp_id = T1.disp_id INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T1.client_id = T3.client_id WHERE T2.type = 'gold' AND T1.type = 'OWNER'

en: Please list the reference names of the drivers who are eliminated in the first period in race number 20.
postgres: SELECT T2.driverRef FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 20 ORDER BY T1.q1 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

en: Please give the name of the race held on the circuits in Germany.
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T2.name FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T1.country = 'Germany'

en: What is the coordinates location of the circuits for Australian grand prix?
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'

en: Give the coordinate position for Abu Dhabi Grand Prix.
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'

en: What's Bruno Senna's Q1 result in the qualifying race No. 354?
postgres: SELECT T1.q1 FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 354 AND T2.forename = 'Bruno' AND T2.surname = 'Senna'

en: What is his number of the driver who finished 0:01:54 in the Q3 of qualifying race No.903?
postgres: SELECT T2.number FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 903 AND T1.q3 LIKE '1:54%'

en: For the Bahrain Grand Prix in 2007, how many drivers not finished the game?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T3.driverId) FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T1.year = 2007 AND T1.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix' AND T2.time IS NULL

en: For all the drivers who finished the game in race No. 592, who is the oldest?
postgres: SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T2.raceId = 592 AND NOT T2.time IS NULL AND NOT T1.dob IS NULL ORDER BY T1.dob ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

en: Who was the player that got the lap time of 0:01:27 in the race No. 161? Show his introduction website.
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T2.forename, T2.surname, T2.url FROM lapTimes AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 161 AND T1.time LIKE '1:27%'

en: For the constructor which got the highest point in the race No. 9 , what is its introduction website?
postgres: SELECT T2.url FROM constructorResults AS T1 INNER JOIN constructors AS T2 ON T2.constructorId = T1.constructorId WHERE T1.raceId = 9 ORDER BY T1.points DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

en: For the driver who set the fastest lap speed, what is his nationality?
postgres: SELECT T1.nationality FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId ORDER BY T2.fastestLapSpeed DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

en: For the drivers who took part in the race in 1983/7/16, what's their race completion rate?
postgres: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT T2.time IS NULL THEN T2.driverId END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T2.driverId), 0) FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId WHERE T1.date = '1983-07-16'

en: List the names of all races that occurred in the earliest recorded year and month.
postgres: SELECT name FROM races WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = (SELECT TO_CHAR(CAST(date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') FROM races ORDER BY date ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) AND TO_CHAR(CAST(date AS TIMESTAMP), 'MM') = (SELECT TO_CHAR(CAST(date AS TIMESTAMP), 'MM') FROM races ORDER BY date ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1)

en: What is the average lap time for Lewis Hamilton in the 2009 Malaysian Grand Prix?
postgres: SELECT AVG(T2.milliseconds) FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN lapTimes AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T3.forename = 'Lewis' AND T3.surname = 'Hamilton' AND T1.year = 2009 AND T1.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'

en: Name the races along with its circuit name and location for f1 races hosted in September 2005.
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T2.name, T1.name, T1.location FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.year = 2005 AND TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.date AS TIMESTAMP), 'MM') = '09'

en: What's the reference name of Marina Bay Street Circuit?
postgres: SELECT circuitRef FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'

en: Which country is the oldest driver from?
postgres: SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE NOT dob IS NULL ORDER BY dob ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

en: Which driver ranked the first in the Canadian Grand Prix in 2007? Please give his reference name.
postgres: SELECT T3.forename, T3.surname, T3.driverRef FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T1.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND T2.rank = 1 AND T1.year = 2007

en: How many circuits are there in Adelaide, Australia?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(circuitId) FROM circuits WHERE location = 'Adelaide' AND country = 'Australia'

en: Which constructor scored most points from Monaco Grand Prix between 1980 and 2010? List the score, name and nationality of this team.
postgres: SELECT SUM(T1.points), T2.name, T2.nationality FROM constructorResults AS T1 INNER JOIN constructors AS T2 ON T1.constructorId = T2.constructorId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T3.raceid = T1.raceid WHERE T3.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND T3.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY T2.name, T2.nationality ORDER BY SUM(T1.points) DESC LIMIT 1

en: How many accidents did the driver who had the highest number accidents in the Canadian Grand Prix have?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.driverId) FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN status AS T3 ON T1.statusId = T3.statusId WHERE T3.statusId = 3 AND T2.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' GROUP BY T1.driverId ORDER BY COUNT(T1.driverId) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

en: Please list the lap records for the circuits in Italy.
postgres: WITH fastest_lap_times AS (SELECT T1.raceId, T1.FastestLapTime, (CAST(SPLIT_PART(T1.FastestLapTime, ':', 1) AS REAL) * 60) + (CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(T1.FastestLapTime, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS REAL)) + (CAST(SPLIT_PART(T1.FastestLapTime, '.', 2) AS REAL) / 1000) AS time_in_seconds FROM results AS T1 WHERE T1.FastestLapTime IS NOT NULL) SELECT T1.FastestLapTime AS lap_record FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS T3 ON T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId INNER JOIN (SELECT MIN(fastest_lap_times.time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds FROM fastest_lap_times INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON fastest_lap_times.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS T3 ON T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId WHERE T3.country = 'Italy') AS T4 ON (CAST(SPLIT_PART(T1.FastestLapTime, ':', 1) AS REAL) * 60) + (CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(T1.FastestLapTime, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS REAL)) + (CAST(SPLIT_PART(T1.FastestLapTime, '.', 2) AS REAL) / 1000) = T4.min_time_in_seconds LIMIT 1

en: What's Angela Sanders's major?
postgres: SELECT T2.major_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'Angela' AND T1.last_name = 'Sanders'

en: Among the students from the Student_Club who attended the event "Women's Soccer", how many of them want a T-shirt that's in medium size?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.event_id) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T2.link_to_member = T3.member_id WHERE T1.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer' AND T3.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

en: Among the events attended by more than 10 members of the Student_Club, how many of them are meetings?
postgres: SELECT T1.event_name FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event GROUP BY T1.event_id HAVING COUNT(T2.link_to_event) > 10 EXCEPT SELECT T1.event_name FROM event AS T1 WHERE T1.type = 'Meeting'

en: List all the names of events that had an attendance of over 20 students but were not fundraisers.
postgres: SELECT T1.event_name FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event GROUP BY T1.event_id HAVING COUNT(T2.link_to_event) > 20 EXCEPT SELECT T1.event_name FROM event AS T1 WHERE T1.type = 'Fundraiser'

en: What is the amount of the funds that the Vice President received?
postgres: SELECT T2.amount FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.position = 'Vice President'

en: List the full name of the Student_Club members that grew up in Illinois state.
postgres: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code WHERE T2.state = 'Illinois'

en: Tell the phone number of "Carlo Jacobs".
postgres: SELECT phone FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Carlo' AND last_name = 'Jacobs'

en: What was Brent Thomason's major?
postgres: SELECT T2.major_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'Brent' AND T1.last_name = 'Thomason'

en: For all the club members from "Business" major, how many of them wear medium size t-shirt?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.member_id) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T2.major_name = 'Business' AND T1.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

en: Which department was the President of the club in?
postgres: SELECT T2.department FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T1.position = 'President'

en: How many cities are there in Orange County, Virginia?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(city) FROM zip_code WHERE county = 'Orange County' AND state = 'Virginia'

en: How many members attended the "Women's Soccer" event?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T2.link_to_member) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'

en: Among all the closed events, which event has the highest spend-to-budget ratio?
postgres: SELECT T2.event_name FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T2.status = 'Closed' ORDER BY T1.spent / NULLIF(T1.amount, 0) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

en: Which student has been entrusted to manage the budget for the Yearly Kickoff?
postgres: SELECT T4.first_name, T4.last_name FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget INNER JOIN member AS T4 ON T3.link_to_member = T4.member_id WHERE T1.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'

en: Which event has the lowest cost?
postgres: SELECT T1.event_name FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget ORDER BY T3.cost NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

en: Based on the total cost for all event, what is the percentage of cost for Yearly Kickoff event?
postgres: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN T3.cost ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(T3.cost), 0) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget

en: How many members of the Student_Club have major in 'Physics Teaching'?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T2.member_id) FROM major AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major WHERE T1.major_name = 'Physics Teaching'

en: Name the event with the highest amount spent on advertisement.
postgres: SELECT T2.event_name FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T1.category = 'Advertisement' ORDER BY T1.spent DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

en: Indicate the cost of posters for 'September Speaker' event.
postgres: SELECT T3.cost FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget WHERE T1.event_name = 'September Speaker' AND T3.expense_description = 'Posters'

en: List the last name of members with a major in environmental engineering and include its department and college name.
postgres: SELECT T2.last_name, T1.department, T1.college FROM major AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major WHERE T2.position = 'Member' AND T1.major_name = 'Environmental Engineering'

en: Please list all the superpowers of 3-D Man.
postgres: SELECT T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = '3-D Man'

en: Among the superheroes with the super power of "Super Strength", how many of them have a height of over 200cm?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Super Strength' AND T1.height_cm > 200

en: Among the superheroes with blue eyes, how many of them have the super power of "Agility"?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id INNER JOIN colour AS T4 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T4.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Agility' AND T4.colour = 'Blue'

en: Please list the superhero names of all the superheroes that have blue eyes and blond hair.
postgres: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.hair_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue' AND T3.colour = 'Blond'

en: Which publisher published the slowest superhero?
postgres: SELECT T2.publisher_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T3 ON T1.id = T3.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T4 ON T3.attribute_id = T4.id WHERE T4.attribute_name = 'Speed' ORDER BY T3.attribute_value NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

en: How many gold-eyed superheroes did Marvel Comics publish?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND T3.colour = 'Gold'

en: What is Copycat's race?
postgres: SELECT T2.race FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Copycat'

en: What are the names of the superheroes with the power of death touch?
postgres: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Death Touch'

en: Between DC and Marvel Comics, which publisher has published more superheroes? Find the difference in the number of superheroes they have published.
postgres: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id

en: Give the publisher ID of Star Trek.
postgres: SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek'

en: List down at least five superpowers of male superheroes.
postgres: SELECT T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T3.id = T2.power_id INNER JOIN gender AS T4 ON T4.id = T1.gender_id WHERE T4.gender = 'Male' LIMIT 5

en: Provide the hair colour of the human superhero who is 185 cm tall.
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T3.colour FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.hair_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T1.height_cm = 185 AND T2.race = 'Human'

en: In superheroes with height between 150 to 180, what is the percentage of heroes published by Marvel Comics?
postgres: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.id), 0) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T1.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180

en: What are the superpowers of heroes with ID 1?
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T2.power_name FROM hero_power AS T1 INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id WHERE T1.hero_id = 1

en: How many heroes have stealth power?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.hero_id) FROM hero_power AS T1 INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id WHERE T2.power_name = 'Stealth'

en: Which superhero has the most durability published by Dark Horse Comics?
postgres: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T3.id = T2.attribute_id INNER JOIN publisher AS T4 ON T4.id = T1.publisher_id WHERE T4.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics' AND T3.attribute_name = 'Durability' ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

en: Calculate the difference between Emil Blonsky's weight and Charles Chandler's weight.
postgres: SELECT (SELECT weight_kg FROM superhero WHERE full_name LIKE 'Emil Blonsky') - (SELECT weight_kg FROM superhero WHERE full_name LIKE 'Charles Chandler') AS CALCULATE

en: State all of 3-D Man's attributes along with their values.
postgres: SELECT T3.attribute_name, T2.attribute_value FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = '3-D Man'

en: Find the ratio between male superheroes and female superheroes.
postgres: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.gender = 'Male' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.gender = 'Female' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END), 0) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id

en: Identify superheroes who can control wind and list their names in alphabetical order.
postgres: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Wind Control' ORDER BY T1.superhero_name NULLS FIRST

en: Are there more in-patient or outpatient who were male? What is the deviation in percentage?
postgres: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M'

en: For patients with severe degree of thrombosis, list their ID, sex and disease the patient is diagnosed with.
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2

en: How many female patients who came at the hospital in 1997 was immediately followed at the outpatient clinic?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(Description AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '1997' AND SEX = 'F' AND Admission = '-'

en: How many of the patients with the most serious thrombosis cases examined in 1997 are women?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND TO_CHAR(CAST(T2."Examination Date" AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '1997' AND T2.Thrombosis = 1

en: What are the symptoms observed by the youngest patient to ever did a medical examination? Identify their diagnosis.
postgres: SELECT T2.Symptoms, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE NOT T2.Symptoms IS NULL ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

en: What is the ratio of male to female patients among all those with abnormal uric acid counts?
postgres: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.UA <= 8.0 AND T1.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.UA <= 6.5 AND T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

en: How many underage patients were examined during the course of the three-year period from 1990 to 1993?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T2."Examination Date") BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T2."Examination Date") - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T1.Birthday) < 18

en: For the patient who was diagnosed with SLE on 1994/2/19, what was his/her anti-Cardiolipin antibody concentration status on 1993/11/12?
postgres: SELECT "aCL IgA", "aCL IgG", "aCL IgM" FROM Examination WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND Description = '1994-02-19') AND "Examination Date" = '1993-11-12'

en: List all patients who were followed up at the outpatient clinic who underwent a laboratory test in October 1991 and had a total blood bilirubin level within the normal range.
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2."T-BIL" < 2.0 AND T2.Date::text LIKE '1991-10-%'

en: How many female patients were given an APS diagnosis?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS'

en: Provide IDs for male patients with ALT glutamic pylvic transaminase (GPT) that have history of ALT glutamic pylvic transaminase (GPT) exceed the normal range.
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GPT >= 60

en: List and group all patients by sex for total bilirubin (T-BIL) level not within the normal range.
postgres: SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."T-BIL" >= 2.0 GROUP BY T1.SEX,T1.ID

en: For patient born between 1936-1956, how many male patients have creatinine phosphokinase beyond the normal range?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(T1.Birthday AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956' AND T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.CPK >= 250

en: Among the patients who were diagnosed with SLE, who is the oldest with normal hemoglobin level. Provide the ID and sex.
postgres: SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.HGB > 10 AND T2.HGB < 17 ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

en: Among the male patients who have a normal level of white blood cells, how many of them have an abnormal fibrinogen level?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450 AND T2.WBC > 3.5 AND T2.WBC < 9.0 AND T1.SEX = 'M'

en: Among the patients with a normal Ig G level, how many of them have symptoms?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG BETWEEN 900 AND 2000 AND NOT T3.Symptoms IS NULL

en: How many patients with a abnormal C-reactive protein don't have their data recorded?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE (T2.CRP = '+') AND T1.Description IS NULL

en: How many patients have a normal level of anti-ribonuclear protein and have been admitted to the hospital?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RNP = 'negative' OR T2.RNP = '0' AND T1.Admission = '+'

en: Among the patients with normal anti-SM, how many of them does not have thrombosis?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SM IN ('negative', '0') AND T1.Thrombosis = 0

en: Among the patients who has a normal anti-scl70, how many of them are female and does not have any symptom?
postgres: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID WHERE (T2.SC170 = 'negative' OR T2.SC170 = '0') AND T1.SEX = 'F' AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL

en: On average how many carcinogenic molecules are single bonded?
postgres: SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT T3.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.bond_type) AS single_bond_count FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T3.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-' AND T3.label = '+' GROUP BY T3.molecule_id) AS subquery

en: Find the triple-bonded molecules which are carcinogenic.
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#' AND T2.label = '+'

en: What elements are in the TR004_8_9 bond atoms?
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

en: Which type of label is the most numerous in atoms with hydrogen?
postgres: SELECT T.label FROM (SELECT T2.label, COUNT(T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'h' GROUP BY T2.label ORDER BY COUNT(T2.molecule_id) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS t

en: What is the percentage of carcinogenic molecules in triple type bonds?
postgres: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id), 0) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#'

en: Please list top three elements of the toxicology of the molecule TR000 in alphabetical order.
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T.element FROM atom AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY T.element NULLS FIRST LIMIT 3

en: What is the percentage of double bonds in the molecule TR008? Please provide your answer as a percentage with five decimal places.
postgres: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.bond_type = '=' THEN T.bond_id ELSE NULL END) AS NUMERIC) * 100 / CAST(COUNT(T.bond_id) AS NUMERIC), 5) AS percentage FROM bond AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR008'

en: How much of the hydrogen in molecule TR206 is accounted for? Please provide your answer as a percentage with four decimal places.
postgres: SELECT ROUND(CAST((CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.element = 'h' THEN T.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T.atom_id), 0)) AS NUMERIC), 4) AS percentage FROM atom AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR206'

en: What are the elements of the toxicology and label of molecule TR060?
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element, T2.label FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR060'

en: Please list top three molecules that have single bonds between two atoms and are not carcinogenic in alphabetical order.
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-' AND T2.label = '-' ORDER BY T2.molecule_id NULLS FIRST LIMIT 3

en: List all the elements of the toxicology of the molecule "TR004".
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T.element FROM atom AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR004'

en: What are the bonds that have phosphorus and nitrogen as their atom elements?
postgres: SELECT T2.bond_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T2.bond_id IN (SELECT T3.bond_id FROM connected AS T3 INNER JOIN atom AS T4 ON T3.atom_id = T4.atom_id WHERE T4.element = 'p') AND T1.element = 'n'

en: Is the molecule with the most double bonds carcinogenic?
postgres: SELECT T1.label FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT T.molecule_id, COUNT(T.bond_type) FROM bond AS T WHERE T.bond_type = '=' GROUP BY T.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(T.bond_type) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

en: What is the average number of bonds the atoms with the element iodine have?
postgres: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.bond_id) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.atom_id), 0) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.element = 'i'

en: List all the elements of atoms that can not bond with any other atoms.
postgres: SELECT DISTINCT T.element FROM atom AS T WHERE NOT T.element IN (SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id)

en: What are the elements of the atoms of TR144_8_19?
postgres: SELECT T2.element FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19'

en: Calculate the total atoms with triple-bond molecules containing the element phosphorus or bromine.
postgres: SELECT COUNT(T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#' AND T1.element IN ('p', 'br')
